questions.qtext: Which of the following is/are the characteristics of Von Neumann architecture?

options.text: Program execution is essentially sequential in nature.
Program and data are stored in same memory.
Program and data are stored in different memories.

questions.solution:
(a, b)
Program and data are stored in same memory. There is shared bus between programs and data.
questions.subject: Technical

questions.qtext: Locality of reference implies that the page reference being made by a process

options.text: will always be to the page used in the previous page reference.
is likely to be one of the pages used in the last few page references.
will always be one of the page existing in memory.
will always leads to a page fault.

questions.solution:
(b)
Locality of reference is based on the fact that a page that is referred is likely to be referred again in the near future.

questions.qtext:
Consider the following sequence of micro-operations:
MBR ← PC
MAR ← X
PC ← Y
Memory ← MBR
Which one of the followings is a possible operation performed by this sequence?
questions.solution:
(d)
It can be seen from 1st and 4th instructions that the control flow is not sequential and the value of PC was stored in the memory, so that the control can again come back to the address where it left the execution. This behaviour is seen in case of interrupt handling.

questions.solution:

A bootstrap loader is a program that resides in the computer’s ROM or other non-volatile memory. It is automatically executed by the processor when turning on the computer.
